changelog.0.1.0: Initial nuclei segmentation bundle: 2D BasicUNet, binary sigmoid output.

task: Nucleus segmentation in H&E whole-slide pathology images
description: Binary 2D segmentation of cell nuclei in RGB patches extracted from whole-slide images. Trained from annotations drawn in QuPath and pushed through a MONAI Label server. The same config is used for interactive fine-tuning inside MONAI Label and for full batch training on SLURM -- see docs/bundle_design.md.
data_source: User-annotated whole-slide images, annotated in QuPath via the MONAI Label extension.
pred_classes: single-channel probability map, sigmoid activated, thresholded at 0.5
intended_use: Research use only. Not a medical device and not validated for clinical or diagnostic use.
